+def median(numbers):
+    """Return the median of a list of numbers.
+
+    - Odd-length list: the middle value after sorting.
+    - Even-length list: the average of the two middle values after sorting.
+    - Empty list: None.
+    """
+    if not numbers:
+        return None
+
+    sorted_numbers = sorted(numbers)
+    n = len(sorted_numbers)
+    mid = n // 2
+
+    if n % 2 == 1:
+        return sorted_numbers[mid]
+    return (sorted_numbers[mid - 1] + sorted_numbers[mid]) / 2
